fact: WHO Comoros reports having supported the Ministry of Health's Direction de l'Information et des Statistiques Sanitaires in producing the health statistical yearbooks for 2021 and 2022, which it describes as health-sector information; the report was published 2025-07-10 and the date the yearbooks came out is not given.

WHO Comoros reports having supported the first quarterly health information bulletins (bulletins trimestriels d'information sanitaire), a quarterly series from the health information system; the report was published 2025-07-10 and gives no date for the bulletins.

The Joint SDG Fund annual report for 2023 says the programme supported the printing and dissemination of the health statistics yearbook 2021 and 2022 and of the quarterly statistical health information bulletins; the report was posted in June 2024 and gives no publication date for those products.
The report lists quarterly statistical health information bulletins as disseminated with programme support in 2023; the report was posted in June 2024 and dates no individual bulletin.

The report says a preliminary mission looked at improving the production of foreign and domestic trade statistics from information exchanged between Comoros customs services, and lists the 2023 health statistical yearbook as still to be drafted and validated; the report was posted in June 2024.
system: Statistiques du commerce extérieur (customs exchange) and Annuaire statistique de la santé 2023
